answer: Before a shot is fired, the explosives regulator checks the magazine serial on the federal licence against the storage log kept at the bunker and the blast plan signed for the site. A magazine serial that shows up at two bunkers trips a licence revocation, a seizure of the stock and a call on the surety bond. A licensed magazine costs 1800, the site inspection 500 and the licence 240, so N fakes cost N x 2540 plus N bunkers and N trips, and a voyage of stolen stock ends at the first audit. An ember in the burn pit and a timber crib at the face change nothing in that log.
